subject: maths

items.q: After 5 heads in a row, is tails 'due'?
items.correct: No — each fair flip is independent; P(heads) stays ½.
items.random_wrong: The probability of heads changes after each flip.
items.why: This is the gambler's fallacy; past results don't affect a fair coin.

items.q: Can a probability be greater than 1?
items.why: 0 = impossible, 1 = certain; all probabilities lie between.
